description: Na₂SrAl₄(SiO₄)₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Iba2 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.72 Å. Sr is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.67-2.94 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.76 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.76 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.63 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four AlO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.61 Å) and three longer (1.63 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, one Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂AlSi trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Sr, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Sr, one Al, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, one Al, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Sr, one Al, and one Si atom.
